2. It uses a lookup strategy, typically based on a key, to check for an existing valid entry before requesting a new one.
3. When the cache space fills or data becomes stale, an eviction policy like LRU (Least Recently Used) or TTL (Time-To-Live) determines which items are removed to make room.
